failures.detail: The failure originates entirely inside a test file (src/lib/__tests__/taxonomy.test.ts line 78). In the 'ID namespace disjointness' test, `subjectIds` is a Set typed with the subject-id union, and the test calls `subjectIds.has(id)` where `id` is a year-level id. Set.has() is typed to the element (subject-id) union, so tsc rejects the year-level id. The implementation types are correct and intentionally disjoint; the test needs to widen/cast the id (e.g. compare over `string`) rather than the code changing. No implementation file is implicated.
